claim: Attention-module-only (fwd-only) throughput for Llama3-8B shapes on 8xL20 PCIe falls from 454.93 iters/s at 8K to 62.75 at 32K to 5.48 at 128K - a 7.25x per-token attention-cost rise from 8K to 32K and 11.5x from 32K to 128K.
stance_target: the attention-only component of the long-context cost, which is larger than the full-step ratio because non-attention FLOPs do not grow
scope_conditions: 8xL20 PCIe, Llama3-8B shapes (32 heads x 128), bs=1, group_num=4, ulysses-degree 2 with lb-ring, forward only

claim: USP achieves 47% MFU on two 8xA800 nodes for Llama3-8B, and notes that Megatron-LM's printed MFU overstates efficiency at long sequences because it does not discount causal-masking waste.
stance_target: the MFU ceiling and the accounting convention used by long-context systems papers
quoted_support: We achieved 47% MFU on two 8xA800 nodes using SP for the LLAMA3-8B ... We have adjusted the MFU computation in Megatron-LM to account only for effective computations under causal masking. As a result, the MFU is notably lower when training with long sequences compared to the MFU figures printed by Megatron-LM.

claim: The USP measurement is attention-module-only and forward-only, so its 7.25x ratio is an upper bound on the full training-step ratio and cannot be used directly as a per-token training cost multiplier.
stance_target: whether the USP ratio can substitute for a full-step measurement
